title: 039 NNPredict -- follow-ups (user request 2026-10-20: 'do all 3'): gate + 24 h grace; the gated model vs st_g24_rev on identical exits; excursion target at H=32
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26); halves are the persistence test (constitution gate 2). Nothing is adopted by this stage; adoption is the user's call.

nnp_lstm_ind_op_gate_g24.change: follow-up 1: the gbb gate AND 24 h stoploss grace (each passed alone vs fw0)

nnp_lstm_ind_op_revx.change: follow-up 2 instrument: st_g24_rev's resolved framework (ARM_D_FAMILY preset, C2 ATR take-profit, volreg2 regime gate, 24 h grace, 4096 startup) on the NNPredict class, ENTRY_MODE triggers (gbb): must reproduce st_g24_rev

nnp_lstm_ind_op_revg.change: follow-up 2: the same framework, ENTRY_MODE trigger_and_model: st_g24_rev's entries filtered by the model; the only difference from the control is the model

nnp_ridge_exc32_op.change: follow-up 3: Ridge retrained on target_mode excursion, HORIZON 32 (8 h); new weights

identity.rule: revx trades_hash == st_g24_rev's on all 15 folds; otherwise the copied framework is a defect: it is fixed (instrument only, rules unchanged) and rerun before revg is read

instrument: per arm: a record for all 15 folds, model trained per fold on its training window (run_folds strict artefact check), and trades in both halves; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE (no P&L read)
alone: judge_one(arm, comparator) with the rule maps; liveness: an arm whose trades change on no fold vs its comparator is INERT (a defect)

decision.nnp_lstm_ind_op_gate_g24: PASS vs the gate -> gate + 24 h grace is the combined candidate default (user's call); FAIL -> the gate alone stays the candidate
decision.nnp_lstm_ind_op_revg: identity must hold. Then PASS with paired IMPROVED -> the model adds value over the gbb trigger on identical exits; PASS otherwise -> the model's filter is no worse than the trigger (reported, nothing claimed); FAIL -> the model's filter costs P&L vs the trigger alone
decision.nnp_ridge_exc32_op: same rule as the threshold amendment: PASS vs nnp_ridge_op -> a candidate target (no selection is re-run; the framework stage's model is unchanged)
